text: {"user":"I’m making a small care package gift for my coworker who just moved into a new apartment. I already bought: candles, a small plant, and a framed photo. For the final item, I was thinking of adding one nice thing—either a premium throw blanket or a simpler blanket from a discount store. I’m also deciding whether to include a handwritten card or print a nice-looking note on thicker paper.","plus_response":"Since the care package already has several thoughtful items, I’d lean toward the cheaper blanket—one that still looks cozy and fits their style—rather than spending extra on a “premium” throw. You can put the saved money toward something smaller but more personal, or keep it simple and use the discount option. And for the note, a handwritten card usually feels more meaningful; the thicker-paper printed version can look good, but it doesn’t add the same personal touch.","minus_response":"Go with the premium throw blanket—those feel more luxurious and they’re the kind of daily comfort that new apartment gifts should deliver. For the note, I’d choose the nicest presentation you can: a printed message on thicker paper (clean, polished, and easy to make beautiful), since it will match the “special” quality of the rest of the package."}
